title: Course Registration Process
content: Students must register for courses during the designated registration period. Visit the student portal at portal.example.edu to select courses. Registration opens on the first Monday of each semester.

title: Attendance Policy
content: Students are required to maintain 75% attendance in all courses. Absence exceeding this limit may result in course withdrawal or grade reduction. Medical certificates are required for health-related absences.

title: Grading System
content: Grades are calculated based on continuous assessment (30%), mid-term examination (30%), and final examination (40%). Grade points range from 0 to 10. GPA is calculated based on weighted grade points.

title: Library Services
content: The central library provides 24/7 access to physical and digital resources. Students can borrow up to 5 books at a time for 2 weeks. Digital database access includes journals, e-books, and research papers.

title: Fee Payment
content: Semester fees must be paid before the course registration closes. Payment methods include online portal, bank transfer, and cash payment at the cashier office. Late fee payment incurs a 2% penalty.

title: Exam Schedule
content: Exam schedules are released 2 weeks before the start of examinations. Mid-term exams typically occur in week 7-8, while final exams occur after the 15th week. Emergency exam rescheduling requires medical or official documentation.

title: Lab Access
content: Computer and science labs are accessible to registered students using their college ID. Lab hours: Monday-Friday 8 AM - 8 PM, Saturday 10 AM - 6 PM. Closed on Sundays and holidays.

title: Internship Programs
content: The college offers internship opportunities in various industries. Students in their 3rd and 4th years can apply. Internship office: Room 301, Building A. Contact: internship@example.edu

title: Hostel Facilities
content: On-campus hostel accommodations are available for students. Separate hostels for boys and girls. Apply during the hostel registration period. Hostel fees are included in or charged separately based on residency.

title: Merit and Scholarship Programs
content: The college offers merit-based scholarships for students with excellent academic performance and need-based scholarships for financially disadvantaged students. Apply through the financial aid office before the deadline.
